title: One-Page Performance Manifest — Darian Cole
body:
Purpose: a single-page operational guide for my personal goals and how I’ll prove progress. Keep short, evidence-driven, and review every Monday morning.

Manifest statement:
I will ship small bets that change product behavior and customer outcomes. I measure success by visible user impact, predictable throughput in my tasks, and learning cycles completed. I trade perfection for consistent, observable forward motion.

Three performance pillars (90-day focus):
1) Customer signal capture — convert qualitative feedback into 3 repeatable telemetry checks (SLO for signal freshness).
  - Leading metric: daily active feedback items triaged (target 4/day).
  - Evidence: workspace label + short example saved in ticket.
2) Throughput reliability — reduce average PR review cycle from 48h to 30h for my scope.
  - Leading metric: PRs merged per week (target 3/week).
  - Evidence: merged-PR list in weekly readout with time-to-merge stat.
3) Outcome experiments — run 2 light A/B experiments that move a product metric (engagement or error surface).
  - Leading metric: experiments launched per quarter (target 2).
  - Evidence: short experiment postmortem with numbers and next step.

Micro-commitments (daily/weekly actions):
- Daily: 15-min triage + 30-min deep work block dedicated to the highest-impact ticket.
- Monday: 20-min planning + update the 1-page manifest with any shifting priorities.
- Wednesday: run micro-retro (what moved, blocked, next 3 actions).
- Friday: 10-min evidence capture and update the personal readout doc.

Weekly check-in template (use as my calendar brief + Slack note):
- Wins (2): short bullets with links to artifacts.
- Signal captured (1–3 items): where and what I logged.
- Blockers: explicit ask (who I need help from + what I need).
- Next week commitments (3): clear, small, measurable.

Monthly readout structure (deliverable to myself/team):
- TL;DR: 1-sentence progress vs pillars.
- Evidence table: metric | baseline | current | delta | link (attach links to tickets, experiments).
- Decisions recommended: keep/stop/scale.
- Calendar asks: meetings or reviews needed.

Mini-retro rubric (5 min):
- What changed this week (data + anecdote).
- Which micro-commitment failed and why.
- Quick action (1) to fix it.

Acceptance criteria for experimental outcomes:
- Improvement >= 3% on the target metric OR a high-quality learning with a clear next step.
- Postmortem written within 3 working days of end.

Risk & boundaries:
- Don’t broaden focus until 2/3 pillars show momentum for two consecutive weeks.
- Blockers that require >2 people or >5 days become a flagged dependency and move to the team backlog.

Open questions (to revisit on next monthly review):
- Is the 4/day feedback triage realistic for product bandwidth?
- Should PR throughput target be per-sprint instead of per-week?
- When to escalate an experiment to wider rollout?

Quick todo (next 7 days):
- Wire up a saved search for fresh feedback (done: create label + one example).
- Ship the small telemetry change to tag feedback sources (PR in draft).
- Run one deep block and record time-to-complete for calibration.

Notes to self: keep this page short. Replace text with links and data as evidence accumulates. If it becomes long, extract to an artifact store and keep only the headline here.

Revision history:
- 2025-11-05 initial draft.
- 2026-02-25 trimmed to three pillars and added acceptance criteria.
- 2026-03-01 clarified weekly template and added explicit evidence steps.
